# kernel-methods

Kernel methods built on the kernels of `kernels`: closed-form kernel ridge regression (`kernelRidge`, `solveKernelRidge`) with the exact leave-one-out shortcuts (`hatDiagonal`, `looPredictions`, `looPress`); ridge regression in the Nystrom and random Fourier feature spaces with the explicit approximation error against the exact fit (`approximateKernelRidge`, `featureRidge`, `ridgeGap`); the choice of the kernel and the ridge by evidence, leave-one-out and generalised cross-validation, by gradient or by grid (`tuneKernelRidge`, `gridKernelRidge`); kernel classifiers (`kernelLogisticRegression`, `importVectorMachine`, `lssvm`, `kernelRidgeClassifier`); multiple kernel learning (`alignmentWeights`, `easyMkl`, `mklAlgorithm`, `fitMultipleKernel`); kernel mean embeddings, the conditional embedding, the kernel Bayes rule and the kernel Stein discrepancy with its test (`meanEmbedding`, `mmdWitness`, `conditionalMeanEmbedding`, `kernelBayesRule`, `steinKernelGram`, `steinGoodnessOfFit`); more online learners (`klms`, `qklms`, `kernelPerceptron`, `kernelPassiveAggressive`, with budgets); kernel CCA and kernel PLS (`kernelCca`, `kernelPlsRegression`); kernel expectile and sparse kernel quantile regression (`kernelExpectileRegression`, `kernelQuantileRegression`); and the online learners that take one observation per step, kernel recursive least squares with approximate-linear-dependence, coherence and sliding-window dictionaries (`krls`, `krlsAlgorithm`, `krlsStep`) and NORMA (`norma`).

- estimator `kernelLogisticRegression`: Kernel logistic regression. `src/lib/kernel-methods/kernel-classifiers.ts:247` `mdml-engine/kernel-methods`
- estimator `kernelRidge`: Kernel ridge regression with exact leave-one-out shortcuts. `src/lib/kernel-methods/kernel-ridge.ts:338` `mdml-engine/kernel-methods`
